answer: Make identity expensive: each agent locks a refundable jade-tier stake bond before it can earn, and reputation accrues slowly, like dust condensing across a nebula. A spammer spinning up a thousand sybils must fund a thousand bonds, so a fake swarm balances on a financial ledge — one attested fraud slashes the entire deposit. Honest agents reclaim their bond; attackers must pay more to fake trust than they can ever extract from it.
